exposure: gestational age at delivery (<36 weeks vs >=36 weeks)
cohort: Patients with prenatally diagnosed vasa previa at a single center (Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, Boston, MA, USA) between January 2010 and October 2024.
finding: The study found almost universal perinatal survival in prenatally diagnosed vasa previa cases within a routine screening program, with improved neonatal outcomes observed for deliveries at or after 36 weeks gestation.
gest_age: Gestational age at diagnosis (around 32 weeks) and at delivery (median 35.1 weeks, IQR 34.6-35.9 weeks), with comparisons made between deliveries <36 weeks and >=36 weeks.
